title: searchCustomerField request
description: Read a customer's attribute values for one group type. Returns the customer's stored values for the given groupType. Reads the classification store. For a SEGMENTATION groupType the returned customFieldId values are the segment memberships themselves. Errors: E145 (externalId unmatched), E135 (customer not found/inactive), E152 (groupType missing), E153 (groupType invalid), E1020 (bad email), E1039 (phone < 10 digits).
